title: Today, July 31st, the bodies of the Iranian martyrs who were martyred a few days ago in the American-Saudi attack on the Iraqi PMF arrived in Iran, Mehran border line.
text:
Today, July 31st, the bodies of the Iranian martyrs who were martyred a few days ago in the American-Saudi attack on the Iraqi PMF arrived in Iran, Mehran border line."

"(The Mehran border crossing is located in Ilam Province, in western Iran)"
